PBW / Wires — Duplicate Contact Analysis

LLM-reviewed · August 2026 · actionable pairs from 235,869 PB/Wires contacts · Wide-net blocking + LLM judgment

DETECTION METHODS
CRD Match—
Same FINRA CRD number — definitively the same physical person in two Salesforce records.
same FINRA CRD number
Email Match—
Same business email address (exact or domain-normalized across known firm alias families: e.g. apollo.com = apollo-advisors.com, ms.com = morganstanley.com).
same email · domain normalized
Name + Phone / ZIP—
Same last name, JW ≥ 75 on first name (catches nicknames), and same 10-digit phone or 5-digit ZIP code.
same last name · JW ≥75 · same phone/ZIP
Name + Firm + State—
Same last name, JW ≥ 75 first name, same firm (first word) and state. Catches advisors who have duplicate records at the same office.
same last name · JW ≥75 · same firm · same state
